research_attempts.query_text: NARA index and official-record context; CIA and Library of Congress access attempts; exact-name and meaningful variant OSS searches; rank or protected-identifier searches where available; employer 1940, occupation, obituary, newspaper, institutional, directory, and archival searches
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Official Army bulk evidence resolves identity, but no reviewed source names a pre-OSS employer.
research_attempts.research_notes: The staged protocol was completed. Discovery-only snippets, genealogy pages, modern directories, relatives, and unsupported namesakes were not used as evidence. Coded Army occupation data were not converted into an employer.
